name: Jēkaba Arkāde
notes: Capacity from OpenStreetMap.

name: Kongresu nams underground
address: Krišjāņa Valdemāra iela 5A (entrance from Kalpaka bulvāris)
notes: Capacity from Rīgas satiksme: 317 places plus marked places for people with reduced mobility. EUR 2/hour 08:00-23:00, EUR 3 overnight, max EUR 18 per 24 h.

name: Galleria Riga
notes: Two underground levels. Capacity is the shopping centre's own "about 120 spaces".

name: Origo P3
notes: Section P3 of Origo's parking. Capacity from the owner, Linstow Baltic: P1 117, P2 82, P3 45 spaces (244 in all; the same page's intro says 250, and origo.lv says 248). Linstow lists P3 as restricted access, entry/exit from Elizabetes iela. On 2026-11-25 P3 was closed to the public.

name: Origo P1 / P2
notes: Sections P1 and P2 of Origo's parking, first listed as Origo One. Capacity from the owner, Linstow Baltic: P1 117 + P2 82 spaces (P3 has 45 more; the same page's intro says 250 in all, and origo.lv says 248). P1 is entered from Satekles iela, P2 from Satekles iela or Elizabetes iela.

name: Marijas iela 2 underground
notes: Opposite Origo. Capacity (270 cars) from neighborhood.lv, not confirmed by the operator.

name: Stockmann
notes: Underground car park connected to the department store, for customers. Capacity (76 spaces) from Live Riga, the city's tourism site.

name: BTA Daugava Athletics Arena
notes: Covered car park on part of the arena's ground floor, near the service entrance. Capacity not published.

name: EuroPark Baznīcas multi-storey
address: Inside the Baznīcas iela 20/22 – Ģertrūdes iela 10 block
notes: Multi-storey garage in the courtyard between Baznīcas iela 20/22 and Ģertrūdes iela 10. Shown as "Europark Baznīcas daudzstāvu" in the 2026-11-25 site check. Capacity not published.

name: Place 11
notes: Parking for the Place Eleven office building. Capacity (323 spaces, including EV and accessible spaces) from Strandeck's project page for the building (completed 2016); not confirmed by the operator.

name: Radisson Blu Hotel Latvija
notes: Car park under the hotel (Elizabetes iela 55), entrance from Baznīcas iela 7. Public use per local report; Radisson lists it as paid guest parking. Capacity (85 spaces) and operator from the owner, Linstow Baltic. Pay in the Snabb or Mobilly app or at the machine.

name: Radisson Blu Elizabete Hotel
notes: Underground garage operated by SNABB, entry/exit from Elizabetes iela. Capacity (26 spaces) from the owner, Linstow Baltic. Trip.com lists it as open to non-guests (about EUR 15/day); hotel guests pay EUR 19/night.

name: Barona centrs
address: Krišjāņa Barona iela 46 (corner of Ģertrūdes iela)
notes: Underground car park of the Barona centrs shopping centre, SNABB zone S7: EUR 2/hour, EUR 12/24 h, EUR 150/month. Number-plate recognition, no tickets; pay in the Snabb or Mobilly app. Pedestrian doors open 08:00-23:00; outside those hours the garage gates open from the app. Capacity not published.

name: VERDE office complex
notes: Underground car park of the VERDE office complex in Skanste, SNABB zone VERDE: first 15 min free, then EUR 2.50/hour, EUR 15/24 h; evening pass (Mon-Fri 18:00-08:00 plus weekends) EUR 40/month. No barrier: prepay in the Snabb or Mobilly app, at verde.snabb.lv or at the machine on site. A screen outside shows free spaces. ELEPORT EV charging customers get 1 h free. Underground capacity not published: verde.lv gives 375 underground and above-ground spaces together. SNABB also runs a surface car park at the same address (zone S9), which isn't on this map.

name: Radisson Blu Rīdzene
notes: Garage under the Radisson Blu Rīdzene hotel, SNABB zone S17: EUR 2.50/hour, EUR 21/24 h. Formerly for hotel guests only; SNABB says it is now open to everyone. Pay in the Snabb or Mobilly app (hotel guests can pay at reception). Driveway entrance off Kalpaka bulvāris, max height 2 m (per OSM). Capacity not published.

name: Berga Bazārs
address: Berga Bazārs courtyard, between Elizabetes and Dzirnavu iela
notes: Open-air EuroPark lot inside the Berga Bazārs quarter (OSM ref EZ). Capacity not published.

name: EuroPark Dzirnavu 78/80
notes: Open-air lot (OSM ref TE). Capacity not published.

name: EuroPark Dzirnavu / Brīvības
address: Dzirnavu iela, near the corner of Brīvības iela
notes: Open-air lot next to Galleria Riga, named "EuroPark - DB" in OSM. Capacity not published.

name: EuroPark Brīvības / Dzirnavu / Baznīcas
address: Courtyard between Brīvības, Dzirnavu and Baznīcas iela
notes: Open-air courtyard lot (OSM ref BB). Has spaces for people with reduced mobility. Capacity not published.

name: ARS Skolas iela
address: Skolas iela, next to the ARS medical centre (Skolas iela 5)
notes: Open-air lot beside the ARS medical centre (OSM ref SA; operator per OSM). Capacity not published.

name: Audēju iela gravel lot
address: Audēju iela, next to Galerija Centrs
notes: Gravel open-air lot by Galerija Centrs (OSM ref AUD). Capacity not published.
